key.name: enabled
key.description: Master toggle for the magnifier and spotlight

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: If true, show the Zoomer icon in the top bar

key.name: size
key.description: Diameter of the magnifier lens in pixels

key.name: shape
key.description: Shape of the magnifier lens and spotlight hole

key.name: rotation
key.description: Angle of rotation in degrees (0-360)

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: 0=Square, 25=Squircle, 50=Circle

key.name: magnifier-enabled
key.description: Master switch for the magnifier feature

key.name: magnifier-zoom
key.description: Zoom level (1.0 - 4.0)

key.name: magnifier-key
key.description: Key or key combination to hold to activate magnifier

key.name: inertia-enabled
key.description: If true, cursor uses spring-damper physics. If false, it follows pointer instantly.

key.name: inertia-stiffness
key.description: Spring stiffness (Higher = Faster/Tighter follow)

key.name: inertia-smoothness
key.description: Velocity retention factor (Higher = More slippery/gliding, Lower = High friction)

key.name: spotlight-enabled
key.description: Darken screen and highlight cursor when key is held

key.name: spotlight-key
key.description: Key or key combination to hold to activate spotlight

key.name: spotlight-opacity
key.description: Darkness of the overlay once the transition has settled

key.name: spotlight-size
key.description: Diameter of the spotlight circle

key.name: spotlight-start-size
key.description: Diameter of the spotlight circle when the transition begins

key.name: spotlight-duration
key.description: Time in milliseconds to shrink from the start distance to the final size (0 = instant)

key.name: spotlight-easing
key.description: Easing curve used when the spotlight appears and disappears

key.name: spotlight-start-opacity
key.description: Darkness of the overlay when the transition begins
